changes: Fixed the output sometimes not turning on at higher voltages into large loads, like big capacitors. If it doesnt start, the card drops the voltage until it does and goes straight back up. WARN plays I when it had to.
The voltage and current digits follow changes about three times faster.
The display no longer blinks when the console makes a request.
0.5A shows as 0.5, not .5, with leading zeros off.
WARN has longer gaps between letters, so its easier to read.
The LOAD key is less sensitive to electrical noise.
console: Shows what last turned the output off.
Says when the card had to drop the voltage to start the output.

changes: Brightness can be set on the card. Hold COARSE - and MODE for 5 seconds, FINE and COARSE change it, APPLY saves it. The slow blinking dot is the default.
The console can set brightness, how bright the dim dots are, leading zeros and the capability bar graduation marks. Settings are saved on the card.
Lower noise on the voltage and current readings. Current reads 0 with no load.
Touch keys work if you were holding the card by them while plugging it in. They recalibrate once you let go.
